_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-paper-watermark (REQ-WMK-001). A meeting says whether the papers opened through decidiq carry the reader's name and the date. PaperWatermarkPolicy decides per paper: on stamps, off never stamps, automatic stamps a closed meeting's papers and a paper under an active confidentiality restriction.

watermarkPapers.title: Watermark papers
watermarkPapers.description: Whether papers opened through decidiq carry the reader's name and the date. automatic stamps them when the meeting is not public or the paper is under an active confidentiality restriction; on always stamps; off never stamps.

watermarkText.title: Watermark text
watermarkText.description: Extra text after the reader's name and the date in the stamp, for example Vertrouwelijk.
